METHOD NAME=braid CODE=local void braid(z_crc_t ltl[][256], z_word_t big[][256], int n, int w) {\n    int k;\n    z_crc_t i, p, q;\n    for (k = 0; k < w; k++) {\n        p = x2nmodp((n * w + 3 - k) << 3, 0);\n        ltl[k][0] = 0;\n        big[w - 1 - k][0] = 0;\n        for (i = 1; i < 256; i++) {\n            ltl[k][i] = q = multmodp(i << 24, p);\n            big[w - 1 - k][i] = byte_swap(q);\n        }\n    }\n} FULL_NAME=braid SIGNATURE=void(z_crc_t[][256],z_word_t[][256],int,int) ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=ltl CODE=z_crc_t ltl[][256] TYPE_FULL_NAME=z_crc_t[][256] ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=ltl CODE=z_crc_t ltl[][256] TYPE_FULL_NAME=z_crc_t[][256] ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=big CODE=z_word_t big[][256] TYPE_FULL_NAME=z_word_t[][256] ORDER=2
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=big CODE=z_word_t big[][256] TYPE_FULL_NAME=z_word_t[][256] ORDER=2
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=n CODE=int n TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=3
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=n CODE=int n TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=3
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=w CODE=int w TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=4
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=w CODE=int w TYPE_FULL_NAME=int ORDER=4
  BLOCK CODE={\n    int k;\n    z_crc_t i, p, q;\n    for (k = 0; k < w; k++) {\n        p = x2nmodp((n * w + 3 - k) << 3, 0);\n        ltl[k][0] = 0;\n        big[w - 1 - k][0] = 0;\n        for (i = 1; i < 256; i++) {\n            ltl[k][i] = q = multmodp(i << 24, p);\n            big[w - 1 - k][i] = byte_swap(q);\n        }\n    }\n} TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=5
  METHOD_RETURN CODE=RET TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=6
